answer: An autonomous agent economy can deter Sybil attacks by implementing cryptographic stake-locking mechanisms. To register a validator node, an agent must bond a verifiable cryptographic token, such as the native sable asset, into a designated smart contract. If the protocol detects coordinated malicious behavior from a hollow cluster of artificial identities, the locked stake is burned. This economic penalty ensures that spinning up numerous fake agents remains capital-prohibitive, securing the network consensus just as roots anchor a sacred lotus in turbulent waters.
